rows.note: Use 馬 as the all-purpose word for the animal, and also for the horse-shaped knight in chess.

example.jyutping: ni1 pat1 maa5 paau2 dak1 hou2 faai3

rows.note: Use 馬肉 specifically when talking about horse meat as food.

example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jau5 maa5 juk6 sik6

rows.note: Use this colloquial label for a big, sturdy man rather than for a literal horse.

example.english: That big horse of a man is our coach.
example.traditional: 嗰個大隻佬係我哋教練。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 daai6 zek3 lou2 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gaau3 lin6
